patches.name: filter-midicc
patches.description: Skip an unchanged Bank MSB / Bank LSB / Program Change on a pattern switch; send each track's on Play

patches.name: generative
patches.description: Generative tracks: hold a track's Seq and press its Arp - Tracks 2..4 go into Flux, a melody loop that keeps changing; Track 1 (Seq + Drum) goes into Pulse, drum pulses spread evenly over each lane's steps - set with the five encoders; the track display shows FL / PU

patches.name: track-cc
patches.description: In Control mode, knobs on the Global channel send on the MIDI channel of the track Control mode was entered from; what they send is kept per pattern, resent after each Program Change or switch to that pattern, and saved with the project
